    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

    await search_input.fill('2065555555')
    
    # Find and click the search button. Assume it's a button with name 'Search'.
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').first
    await search_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # After searching, return the page content as-is to capture any customer details.
    result_text = await page.content()
    return result_text
